definition activities, including content specifications, process requirements, and deployment follow-up across relevant Technical Data domains.- Authoring Rules & Standards Compliance: Deploy and enforce product definition and authoring rules while ensuring internal and external graphical requirements (A4A, ASD, industry standards, and Instructions for Continued Airworthiness – ICA) are met.- Product Network Leadership: Lead Product Network processes and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders on transverse Technical Data topics.- Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Identify, capture, and drive evolution and innovation needs for Technical Data graphics and 3D solutions to enhance customer satisfaction and Technical Data maturity.- Customer Training & Enablement: Define Technical Data training and awareness content to ensure proper product utilization across airlines, MROs, lessors, field representatives, flight lines, and delivery centers.- Customer & Technical Support: Support customers and collaborate across functions to provide timely, accurate responses to technical queries and contribute to overall product and service strategy.Desired skills and qualifications- Education: Completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Aerospace Engineering, Technical Communication/Documentation, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification.- Technical Data Expertise: Proven experience in aviation Technical Data / Technical Publications, aircraft maintenance documentation, and configuration management.- Graphical & Authoring Standards: Strong knowledge of 2D/3D technical illustration workflows, CAD/3D simplified modeling, and aviation documentation standards (e.g., ASD S1000D, A4A iSpec 2200, ICA).- Product & Process Management: Experience defining technical product specifications, managing complex engineering/supplier interfaces, and driving process improvements.- Communication & Stakeholder Leadership: Strong cross-functional coordination
